myData.title: Amakuru yanjye
myData.body: Kuramo ibyo MediLink ibika byose kuri wowe n'abo mu muryango wawe: amadosiye, imiti, fagitire, inyandiko n'ibirego, muri dosiye imwe. Kugira ngo ukosore ikintu, gifungure uhitemo Tanga ikibazo.
myData.done: Dosiye yawe yakuweho. Yibike ahantu hizewe: irimo amakuru y'ubuzima bwawe.

title: Ibirego byanjye
intro: Iyo hari icyanditswe cyangwa cyakozwe nabi (amafaranga, imiti wahawe, kutaza kwanditswe), ivuriro risuzuma inyandiko rigafata icyemezo mu minsi 10.
emptyBody: Kugira ngo utange ikirego, fungura uruzinduko, umuti cyangwa inyandiko uhitemo Tanga ikibazo.
fromItem: Fungura uruzinduko, umuti cyangwa inyandiko ikibazo kirebaho, hanyuma uhitemo Tanga ikibazo.
whatWrongHint: Vuga ibyabaye n'ibyo wari witeze. Ivuriro naryo ribona inyandiko.
tooShort: Vuga ikibazo mu nteruro imwe cyangwa ebyiri.
clinicalNote: MediLink ntica urubanza ku buvuzi. Ku kibazo cy'ubuvuzi, vugana n'ubuyobozi bw'ivuriro cyangwa urugaga rw'abaganga.
statementHint: Idosiye ntiyahinduwe. Itangazo ryawe ribikwa hamwe na yo, kandi umuntu wese uyisoma araribona.

next.info_requested: Ivuriro ryakubajije ikintu. Subiza hano hepfo.
next.resolved: Emera icyemezo, cyangwa ucyange mu minsi 14 MediLink ifate icyemezo.
next.closed: Ushobora kongera kugifungura rimwe mu minsi 30 ufite amakuru mashya.
